children: VIRCO MFG CORPORATION reported results for the 2026 quarter, with net sales of $87.47M and diluted EPS of $0.55, versus $92.09M and $0.65 in the prior-year quarter; net income was $8.61M compared with $10.19M a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per common share”.
Revenue trend: Net sales were down about 5–6% year over year for the quarter and year-to-date; excluding disaster recovery shipments the decline was roughly 4%.
Seasonality & channel timing: Roughly half of annual revenue ships June–August; the company expects most of the current backlog to be delivered in Q3.
Demand drivers: Macroeconomic uncertainty and state/local budget timing weighed on school furniture orders.
Operations & inventory: Management reduced production to control inventory; backlog increased about 13% versus the prior year.
Cost pressures & pricing: Material, energy and delivery costs rose; modest price increases have been enacted but may not fully offset cost pressure.
